decisions.reason: Correctly locates the partial/runningCalls/turnEnds reads in Pet.tsx, but its projection-vs-switch classification is contradicted by the rubric: it speculates running and runningCalls are projection-safe while partial/turnEnds must switch immediately, never identifying the chat legacy projection (views.get('chat')?.legacy) or the target-owned Chat/useChat access.
Locates the running read but treats it as a projection-derivable snapshot field; never explains it belongs to the Session/useSession lifecycle seat outside chat legacy.

Locates the removed ConversationSnapshot/ClientContext runtime imports and legitimately defers exact new symbols, but never locates the package.json client.inject entry and does not repoint Context to scoped cordis.

Mentions scope.slots.register exists but wrongly concludes index.ts is unaffected by the migration; no explanation of slots.inject, Context augmentation, ui-renderer ownership, or slot name/lifetime preservation.
Explicitly declines to cite any card identifiers, so no DSH-0.1.2-A1-03 mapping and no card-grounded projection/immediate separation; per rubric a bare or absent card ID earns zero.
